composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_4 uses a variable-speed mechanical scribe tool to gently strip away flakes of jet black oil shale matrix from the extensive paddle bones of an Eurhinosaurus specimen. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
